in_hebrew.name: שאונחו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'שאון' (Sa'on) which means 'to help, save'. The name Sauncho is derived from this root and means 'one who saves' or 'helper'.

in_greek.name: Σαουνχός
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'σαῦο' (sauo) which means 'to save' or 'help'. The name Sauncho is derived from this root and means 'one who saves' or 'helper' in Greek.

in_latin.name: Sanctus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'sanctus' which means 'holy, pure'. The name Sauncho does not have a direct translation in Latin, but it can be associated with the idea of being a 'holy helper' or 'pure savior'.
